_about: Settings and per-clip data for tools/video_finish. Every number here was measured, not guessed; see README.md for how. Change a value here, not in the code.

plate.about: Minimal fitness studio, peach wall, dark mat with orange edge, dumbbell racks both sides (from Charles, 2026-11-27, 'Minimal_fitness_studio_with_two_dumbbells.png'). Mat back edge ~0.71, front edge ~0.98 of frame height. Previous plate kept as plates/cfc_gym_mat_front_1672x941.png.

proportion.about: Size depends on depth: on-screen length = size_per_depth[body_kind] x (contact line - horizon), as fractions of frame height. Measured 2026-11-27 with the same cut-out model from Charles's white-background proportion check ('Five-position_exercise_scale_comparison.png', 1672x941; same layout as the in-room version, which the dumbbell rack spoils for cut-outs): prone 0.830 long at contact 0.942 and supine 0.530 long at 0.762 give the horizon at 0.444 and lying 1.667; standing arms-up boy 0.652 head to feet at 0.843 gives standing 1.634 (the runner agrees within 5%); kneeling boy 0.448 wide, feet to head, at 0.803 gives kneeling 1.248. body_kind 'kneeling' means body_length_px is the feet-to-head WIDTH in the push-up. Charles: standing moves at the very front of the frame; floor moves a small bit back (contact_line_frac). With these values standing Mark is ~0.83 of frame height, lying ~0.76 long, kneeling ~0.57 wide.

loop.about: Joint score = change across the loop joint divided by the clip's median frame-to-frame change. Under 1.5 reads as continuous; 1.5-3 a slight hitch; over 3 a visible jump.

matte.about: Brightness keying fails on these clips: Mark's grey shoes (~220) match the white studio backdrop (216-230) and the floor shadow is only slightly darker. The person-segmentation model separates both. ~1.1 s per 720p frame on CPU.

limits.about: Each job holds its frames in memory; six at once ran out of memory in a 7 GB workspace. Two at a time is safe.

toe.title: 1 Toe touch
toe.measured: bounding-box height at frames 20-26 (arms forward, head to feet)
toe.notes: Only one repetition, so the joint shows a slight hitch; re-render with 2-3 repetitions. Flow cropped the raised hands at the top of the frame, so at the reference size the fingertips end at a straight line in mid-air: re-render with empty space above the raised hands. No backbend at the top, unlike the card's fourth pose.

situp.title: 2 Head-only partial sit-up
situp.notes: After frame ~104 the clip flips him round; never use frames past it. The clip ends before he is fully back down, so a forward cut jumps (3.49); ping-pong (forward then backward) has no joint.

legraise.title: 3 Alternating prone leg raise
legraise.measured: bounding-box width lying flat, frames 0-8 and 60-70, with the vignette excluded (value < 150)
legraise.notes: Alternating exercise: the loop must contain BOTH legs. With the default minimum length the finder chose a 3.3 s loop of one leg, so this clip needs min_cycle_seconds 5.5.

kneepushup.title: 4 Kneeling push-up
kneepushup.measured: feet-to-head WIDTH, median of 12 frames from video_finish.py measure (max 1107). Sized with the kneeling rule from the proportion check. (Earlier tries: shin-length estimate 1550 made him too small; a calibration against the first reference image did not carry over.)
kneepushup.notes: Most zoomed-in source (about 2.2-3x the standing clips). A wider re-render ('full body, camera farther back') would look sharper than shrinking.

run.title: 5A Run in place
run.measured: median bounding-box height over the clip (portrait 784x1168 source)

scissor.title: 5B Gentle scissor hops
scissor.measured: median bounding-box height over the clip
scissor.notes: A small bounce, not the split-leg exchange (traveler: not a valid scissor). The top of the hair touches the top of the source frame in the hops.
